description:
PUBLIC NOTICE
SHERIFF’S SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION,
GLOUCESTER COUNTY
DOCKET NO.: F-010121-25
SHERIFF’S NO.: 26000888
Plaintiff:
GS MORTGAGE-BACKED SECURITIES TRUST 2021-RPL1
Vs
Defendant:
CHRISTINE A. CURRIE
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered, issued out of the above stated Court, will be exposed for sale at Public Venue, on Wednesday, July 22, 2026, to-wit, at 2 o’clock in the afternoon prevailing time, at 1 N. Broad Street, Ceremonial Courtroom 201 in the City of Woodbury, County of Gloucester and State of New Jersey, all the following described real estate, that is to say:
Property being known as: 80 HOLLY DRIVE WEST DEPTFORD, NJ 08096 and LOT: 10 BLOCK: 356.11
LOCATED IN THE TOWNSHIP OF WEST DEPTFORD, COUNTY OF GLOUCESTER AND THE STATE OF NEW JERSEY
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: .209 AC
NEAREST CROSS STREET: ASH AVENUE
BEGINNING AT A POINT IN THE SOUTHWESTERLY CURVED LINE OF HOLLY DRIVE (60.00 FEET WIDE), SAID POINT BEING NORTHWESTWARDLY AND A TOTAL ARC AN TANGENT DISTANCE OF 628.72 FEET FROM THE END OF THE CURVE CONNECTING SAID LINE OF HOLLY DRIVE WITH THE NORTHWESTERLY LINE OF ASH AVENUE (A/K/A ASH ROAD), SAID CONNECTING CURVE HAVING A RADIUS OF 25.00 FEET, SAID BEGINNING POINT BEING IN THE DIVISION LINE BETWEEN LOTS 9 AND 10, BLOCK 11 ON PLAN HEREINAFTER MENTIONED; EXTENDED THENCE
ESTIMATED UPSET PRICE: $192,538.46 AND ANY ADDITIONAL SUMS AS ORDERED BY THE COURT
OCCUPANCY STATUS: UNKNOWN
PURSUANT TO A ATAX SEARCH OF 05/27/2026; 2026 QTR 2 DUE: 05/01/2026 $1,240.82 PAID ADDED ASSESSMENTS: PENDING ADDED/OMITTED ASSESSMENT FROM DATE OF CERTIFICATE OF OCCUPANCY OR ASSESSOR'S INSPECTION OF PROPERTY. WATER: WEST DEPTFORD TWP. ACCT: 1208009 0 TO: 03/10/2026 $135.66 PAID SUBJECT TO FINAL READING. SEWER: WEST DEPTFORD TWP. ACCT: 1208009 0 03/17/2026 - 04/30/2026 $159.50 PAID
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
The approximate amount of the Judgment sought to be satisfied by said sale is $174,481.80
The purchaser must pay 20% of the purchase price in cash, certified check, cashier’s check, or treasurer’s check, balance to be paid within 30 days.
A deed to be delivered to the purchaser within 30 days from the date of sale, with lawful interest on the balance due, from the 11th day after sale, until the balance is paid.
Any eligible defendant/party interested in purchasing this property through the NJ Community Wealth Preservation Program set forth in NJ A5664 can find more information on our website at https://www.gloucestercountynj.gov/564/Foreclosure-Procedures.
Sales will begin promptly at 2:00pm. Please arrive shortly before this time to check in if you plan on bidding.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any persons claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Seized as the property of the Defendant, and taken in execution at the suit of the Plaintiff, and to be sold by
Carmel M. Morina,
Gloucester County Sheriff
Advertised online at: https://salesweb.civilview.com/Sales/SalesSearch?countyId=19
Date: June 15, 2026
Firm: FRENKEL LAMBERT WEISS WEISMAN & GORDON, LLP
Judgement Date: 5/21/2026
